summary: Tested new Inventory page (backend job + frontend UI) end-to-end. Ran the live SAP job twice via direct API + via UI reload: first run took ~100s and returned 3178 items with 946 valued (SAP Standard Costs responded), second run (page reload) returned 3178 items but costs were unavailable this time (unit_cost/total_value showed '—' gracefully, page still fully loaded) - confirms both the valued and degraded code paths work as designed. All UI elements verified: nav tab positioned correctly between Purchasing Plan and Admin and highlights active; loading state shown while job runs; 3 stat cards render with correct Indian comma formatting (e.g. 7,61,72,401.94 / INR 22,44,12,577.26); search input filters live (BOX -> 224/3178); Category filter (All/Uncategorized/real categories) filters correctly (Uncategorized -> 2229/3178); Site filter shows real site names (8 sites, e.g. RADISH TECHNOLOGIES-P2W) and filters correctly (52/3178) with pagination correctly resetting to page 1 on filter change; row click expands/collapses location sub-row showing Site/Logistics Area, Stock Status, Qty; pagination prev/next works, 50 rows/page confirmed in DOM, page counter correct (Page 1 of 64 for full set). Light regression: BOM Explorer/Purchasing Plan nav and page load confirmed working, consistent with iterations 24-27 all-pass history.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_service.py and sap_inventory_client.py are clean, well-documented, gracefully degrade on SAP Standard Costs failure (try/except around get_standard_costs, falls back to unit_cost=None/total_value=None) exactly as described - verified live in both a valued and non-valued run.
InventoryPage.js: filters/pagination/expand-collapse logic is correct and matches spec (page resets to 1 on search/category/site change via useEffect, PAGE_SIZE=50 enforced via slice).
No bugs found in this session's new Inventory feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory feature fully verified this round via direct API polling (2 separate live job runs) and Playwright UI testing (nav tab, stat cards, search, category filter, site filter, pagination, row expand/collapse). No open bugs. SAP Standard Costs intermittent timeout behavior (mentioned in problem statement) was actually observed live on the 2nd run and confirmed to degrade gracefully exactly as expected - not a bug. All prior iteration 24-27 features unaffected.
